title: Empathic Conversations: A Multi-level Dataset of Contextualized Conversations
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is the creation of a dataset and baseline models specifically designed to measure, analyze, and predict empathy. Empathy is a fundamental component of moral psychology and ethical behavior. The research aims to enable the development of more empathetic AI, which is an objective within applied AI ethics. Therefore, it constitutes a work that benchmarks a core aspect of ethics/morality.
